content.text:
audit                          Collection of all audits in our project
audit-all-vulnerabilities      Scans production and dev dependencies with severity from medium to critical
audit-licenses                 Check dependency licences against ./allowed-licenses
audit-runtime-vulnerabilities  Scans the dependencies that reach the bundle, medium severity and up
audit-secrets                  Scan the working tree for committed secrets with trivy
build                          Build the widget for the environment selected with MISE_ENV
check                          Every check that has to pass before a commit
check-build-artifacts          Verify dist/ holds exactly one JS file and no CSS file
check-posthog-schema           Report whether the generated PostHog schema still matches the project
create-new-tag                 Tag the next release and push it
deploy                         Deploy, roll back or delete: --staging, --production or --preview --name <name>
format                         Check formatting with prettier
generate-app-wrapper           Refresh the Familienportal host page snapshot (--force to refetch)
generate-sbom                  Write the CycloneDX bill of materials
link-check                     Check the external links in the sources and the documentation
lint                           Lint TypeScript sources with oxlint
pull-posthog-schema            Regenerate the typed PostHog schema from the project
release-notes                  Render the changelog of the most recent tag to stdout
start                          Serve the widget inside the Familienportal host page snapshot
static-checks                  Every check that needs no test run
stylelint                      Lint CSS sources with stylelint
test-suite                     Run the vitest suite
type-check                     Type-check the project with tsc
=== hooks content ===
#!/bin/sh
test "${HK:-1}" = "0" || exec hk run pre-commit --from-hook "$@"
#!/bin/sh
test "${HK:-1}" = "0" || exec hk run commit-msg --from-hook "$@"

observation.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="/root/.local/bin:/root/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH" && mise tasks 2>&1 | head -50; echo "=== hooks content ==="; cat .git/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/commit-msg
